messages:
olivia: heads-up — starting tri-zone deploy today 22:00 UTC. Sequence: US -> EU -> APAC. Pinned image: redwood/inference:v3.4.1. Canary slice = 2% user traffic. Release window 22:00–02:00 UTC. Please confirm capacity & warm pools.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] rollout job rl-20260321-1729001234 created; scheduled slices: US 22:00, EU +30m, APAC +60m. Will post smoke results and holdpoints.

maya: US warm pool ready — 120k QPS cushion, 4x p4d nodes reserved. Autoscale floor set to 8 pods.

raj: EU has planned maintenance 23:15–23:45 — recommend shifting EU slice to +45m (23:15) to avoid overlap. APAC capacity: we have 3 spare machines in sg region.

tony: rollback triggers: >5% error rate sustained for 3 consecutive minutes OR latency p95 >750ms for canary. If canary fails, immediate pinback to v3.4.0 and halt promotion. Notify #incidents and ops-oncall.

sam: smoke test command — run smoke-harness against canary:
```bash
./smoke_run --target rl-20260321-1729001234 --slice us-canary
```
Expect green within 2 mins.

maya: did a local dry-run, KV cache primed, no obvious regressions. Will monitor token-level cost and backpressure.

olivia: confirmed. @raj — can you shift EU slice to +45m? also add a manual hold at EU start to validate warm pool before promoting beyond 2%. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: EU start shifted +45m. Inserted holdpoint 'eu-validate' before promoting traffic from 2% -> 20%.

raj: done. also added capacity backfill plan: if EU warm pool <75% before start, spin 2 additional nodes and delay by 10 mins. Logging the plan in ops runbook.

sam: adding checklist: 1) smoke green 2) p95 <250ms 3) error rate <0.5% 4) tracing ok 5) rollback hookup verified. I'll post results as green/yellow/red.

olivia: perfect. If APAC region sees thermal events we fallback to eu regional-standby — deploy-bot should shift traffic to standby automatically. @tony — ops-oncall ok with that?

tony: ops-oncall ack. escalation: page if >2 min manual intervention needed. I'll be watching—ready to take manual rollback.

maya: pre-warm started for APAC, ETA ~15m.

deploy-bot: smoke result (US canary): PASS — 2% traffic, errors 0.07%, p95 180ms. Holding for 5m observation.

olivia: nice. Hold for 5 — then greenlight EU holdpoint. After EU is validated we proceed to APAC. Post release notes snippet in #release-notes and tag product.

sam: quick note — if EU warmup shows cache cold-start we will run a priming job: `curl -X POST https://internal/prime?job=kv&slice=eu` before promotion.

raj: noted. I'll keep the EU holdpoint manual until priming completes.

olivia: thanks everyone — callout for followups: if any region shows >0.5% increase in token cost or unexpected tracing spans, abort and pin back. Otherwise proceed with staggered ramp as planned. :white_check_mark:
